component.name: Perun
component.summary: Steam launch options and Proton manager for Linux
Opcje uruchamiania i Proton dla gier Steam

description.p: Perun is a GTK4/libadwaita editor for Steam launch options on Linux. It lists installed games and non-Steam shortcuts (Battle.net, GOG…), can also show uninstalled games Steam already cached for the account, sets Proton versions, GameMode, MangoHud, and can download GE-Proton and Proton-CachyOS into compatibilitytools.d. Game settings export to a JSON file another Perun can import.

Perun to edytor opcji uruchamiania Steam na Linuksie (GTK4/libadwaita). Pokazuje zainstalowane gry i skróty spoza Steam (Battle.net, GOG…), a na życzenie też niezainstalowane gry z pamięci biblioteki konta. Ustawia Protona, GameMode, MangoHud i potrafi doinstalować GE-Proton oraz Proton-CachyOS. Ustawienia gier można wyeksportować do JSON i wczytać w Perunie na innym komputerze.

ul.li: Launch options written to localconfig.vdf / shortcuts.vdf
Install GE-Proton and Proton-CachyOS from GitHub
Steam starts in the Library and can hide games that are not installed locally
Export and import per-game launch options and Proton

description.p: The Proton list follows the October 2026 Steam client and includes the Proton Stable alias together with the other tools Steam offers.
Export one selected game as well as every customized game. The interface can be Polish, English, or German.
Perun can set the Steam friends status before it starts the client. The native launcher window uses the same dock icon as the Perun shortcut.
Steam can start in the Library and show only locally installed games. Perun lists the rest of the cached account library and exports or imports per-game launch options and Proton.
Flatpak packaging, multi-distro installer, Proton downloads, non-Steam shortcuts, 120 FPS pacing helpers.
